caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a drop-front writing surface. The cabinet features a rectangular shape and a marbleized brown and tan coloration throughout its surface. It is supported by two prominent vertical columns on each side, which are reddish-brown with gold bases and capitals. The front of the cabinet includes three large lower drawers, each with a brass or gold handle and keyhole. Above these drawers, the central section contains a pull-down writing surface, held by metal chains on each side. Behind the writing surface, there is a series of small drawers and compartments, with the drawers featuring a light brown marbled appearance and small round knobs. The central compartment is topped with a triangular pediment and flanked by miniature columns, designed in a similar color pattern to the larger side columns. The overall composition is centered on the page, and the background is a plain off-white color.
title: Secretary
